topics.description: The DOJ has opened a federal civil rights investigation into the death of Alex Pretti, who was shot by ICE agents in Minnesota. The investigation is ongoing, with the FBI now leading the probe.
topics.reason: The shooting of Alex Pretti has sparked widespread outrage and protests across the country.

topics.description: A $9B welfare fraud investigation is underway in Minnesota, with Governor Walz and Attorney General Ellison set to testify before a House committee.
topics.reason: The alleged $9B welfare fraud has raised concerns about the management of public funds in Minnesota.
